name: Paste LaTeX Fixer
description: Detects the paste scenario automatically (AI math text / web formulas / code content / plain text), repairs by policy with hints; right-click a selection to convert both ways
convertSelection: Force-convert the selected content to a formula
alreadyMath: The caret is already inside a formula
looksNotMath: The selection does not look like a formula; please check it
noChange: Nothing that needs conversion was detected
noSelection: Select the text to process in the document first
settingCodeDesc: How to handle pasted content detected as code or configuration text (CSS/HTML/JSON/JS etc.)
settingAIDesc: How to handle pasted content detected as AI chat math text (broken formulas with \( \) \[ \] $$ etc.)
settingWebDesc: How to handle pasted content that comes from a web page (with MathML/KaTeX/MathJax markup)
settingMixedDesc: How to handle content where math signals are mixed with ordinary prose
settingUndelimitedDesc: How to handle pasted content with bare LaTeX commands (\lor, \neg and the like without delimiters, common in AI plain text); Smart = wrap formula fragments in $..$ automatically, Conservative = paste as-is with a hint, Off = no detection and no hint
settingHintsDesc: Show the detected scenario after pasting (e.g. detected as code content, repaired N formulas)
hintCode: Detected as code content; pasted as-is. To convert formulas: select them and right-click "Force convert to formula" (the policy can be changed in settings)
hintAI: Detected as AI math text; repaired {n} formulas
hintAIPassive: Detected as AI math text; not repaired automatically
hintWeb: Detected as web formulas; converted {n} formulas
hintWebPassive: Detected as web formulas; not converted automatically
hintMixedPassive: Math content detected; not repaired automatically
hintUndelimited: Undelimited LaTeX detected (bare backslash commands, not converted automatically)
hintUndelimitedFixed: Detected as undelimited LaTeX formulas; converted {n} fragments automatically
hintSwitchedConservative: Switched to "Conservative (hint only)"; you can change it back in settings
hintSwitchedSmart: Switched to "Smart"; you can change it back in settings
crossBlockRefuse: Cross-block operation refused: select whole paragraphs before converting (this protects block references and block types)
batchPartial: Converted some paragraphs; headings, code and blocks with complex formatting were skipped
blockNeedsWholeBlock: For a block-level formula, select the whole paragraph before converting
blockRichRefuse: This block contains complex formatting (bold, links, inline code etc.); select only the plain-text part you want to process
blockTypeRefuse: Whole-block conversion is not supported for this block type (the block type is kept unchanged)
inCodeRange: Code areas are not part of formula conversion
hintRichPreserved: Complex rich text detected (links, images, tables etc.); pasted as-is to avoid losing formatting. You can select a formula and right-click "Force convert to formula"
hintPasteRepair: Repaired {n} formulas that failed to render (they would otherwise show KaTeX parse error)
copyMarkdownEmpty: Select the blocks to copy first
diagNone: There is no paste record to export yet
diagCopied: Could not write the file; diagnostics copied to the clipboard instead
hintCompat: Another plugin ({names}) also rewrites pasted content, so the two may overwrite each other; keep only one, or set this plugin to "Conservative"
